svg.text: RESUME
SAM RIVERA
Phoenix, AZ | sam.rivera@example.com
OBJECTIVE
Distribution leader with 19 years from frontline fulfillment to operations management. Oversees 3 shifts
and 85 staff, combining workload planning, inventory controls, and supervisor development. Background
includes hands-on delivery, collaboration across departments, reporting, staff support and planning.
Interested in a senior position that builds on this experience and offers the opportunity to take on
broader responsibility.
SUMMARY OF QUALIFICATIONS
Hardworking and dependable with a can-do attitude. Experienced in all aspects of warehouse work,
including receiving, shipping, picking, packing, scheduling, supervising, inventory, training, and
solving problems.
WORK HISTORY
Director of Operations | Copper Distribution Co. | 2020–present
• Responsible for receiving, picking, packing and shipping operations, including daily staffing, workload
allocation and supervisor meetings. Review order backlogs, address attendance and equipment issues,
coordinate with customer service and arrange coverage between shifts. Prepare daily reports and follow up
on incomplete work. Oversee 3 shifts and 85 staff through 6 supervisors, setting daily priorities and
reviewing service, accuracy, and capacity.
• Review picking accuracy, investigate order discrepancies and discuss corrective actions with supervisors.
Work with warehouse staff on scanning procedures, update instructions and reinforce expectations during
shift meetings. Coordinate cycle counts, investigate inventory differences and ensure exceptions are
communicated to the appropriate department. Introduced a scan-and-verify checkpoint; recorded picking
errors fell from 2.1% to 1.2% over the next quarter.
• Work with supervisors to review pick routes, slotting and workload distribution. Use order-frequency
information to identify changes to pick zones and discuss operational constraints with staff. Support
training, review standard work, help resolve carrier issues and prepare for seasonal changes in order
volume. Rebalanced pick zones using order-frequency data, reducing average travel time per sampled pick
route by 18%.
Shift Supervisor | Copper Distribution Co. | 2013–2020
Scheduled and coached a 14-person outbound shift handling approximately 1,200 orders per day.
Coordinated coverage, resolved inventory and shipping exceptions, and trained new staff on standard work
and scanning procedures. Maintained supporting documentation, kept team priorities current and provided
updates during regular planning and review meetings. Worked with colleagues to resolve requests and
communicate outstanding work.
Education / training
M.B.A. Operations | Desert State University | 2015; B.S. Business Administration | Desert State
University | 2007
Shift planning, inventory control, cycle counting, WMS, standard work, coaching
Warehouse Associate | Mesa Supply Co. | 2007–2013
Handled order picking, receiving discrepancies, and weekly cycle counts before promotion into shift
leadership. Reconciled receiving exceptions with colleagues and helped new starters learn warehouse systems
and daily routines. Built practical knowledge of the organization’s systems and procedures, maintained
working records and supported colleagues with daily priorities.
